name: App Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Launch · Group · Bind · Inspect, now with a dock: all your apps and plugins in one theme-aware popup. Type to launch; pull it wide for folders or cards and drag apps between groups; pin apps to an optional dock (any free edge, auto-hide, grow on hover); see updates and newly installed apps at a glance and update plugins in one click; give any app a global shortcut on a key map that shows who owns every key; open App info. Eight languages.
